description: Depth images of the course box from the app's two simulated depth cameras. Simulated, not measured.

depthFormat.layout: row-major, top row first, width*height values
depthFormat.meaning: optical-axis depth at the pixel centre (not ray length)

cameraConvention: Camera frame C: +x right, +y down, +z forward. p_W = R_WC p_C + t_WC. Pixel (u, v) has its centre at (u + 0.5, v + 0.5); p_C = z [(u + 0.5 - cx)/fx, (v + 0.5 - cy)/fy, 1].

processing.voxelRule: cell index k = floor(p/voxelSize + 0.5) per axis; cells are centred on integer multiples of voxelSize
processing.neighborRule: distance <= radius (inclusive, query included); if more than cap, the cap nearest; ties by lower sample index
processing.queryRule: among candidate pixels of the preset camera whose clean sample is inside the crop, the one whose clean sample is nearest to the target; ties by lower pixel index; sparse/noisy candidates are the kept pixels

clean.label: Clean
clean.description: Depth images as captured by the simulated depth cameras.

sparse-noisy.label: Sparse/noisy
sparse-noisy.description: Every third pixel in each image direction, with Gaussian noise added to the optical-axis depth. One fixed draw; illustrative, not a sensor model.
sparse-noisy.generator: For camera index i (A = 0, B = 1): rng = mulberry32(seed + 1000 i). Visit pixels in raster order (v outer, u inner). Keep a pixel when u mod stride = phase and v mod stride = phase; all others become 0. For each kept pixel with clean depth z > 0, draw u1 = 1 - rng(), u2 = rng(), g = sqrt(-2 ln u1) cos(2 pi u2), and store float32(z + sigma g) (0 if not positive). No numbers are drawn for dropped or invalid pixels.

face.label: Face
face.caption: Query at the middle of the +x face
face.question: On one flat face, does the fitted normal change when the radius grows?

near-edge.label: Near edge
near-edge.caption: Query on the +x face, 15 mm below the top edge
near-edge.question: The box stays fixed. What happens to the fit when the radius reaches the top edge?

sparse-noisy.label: Sparse/noisy
sparse-noisy.caption: Query near the middle of the +x face; every 3rd pixel in each direction, depth noise σ = 2 mm
sparse-noisy.question: With few, noisy samples, how much does the fit depend on the radius?

generator.source: the app's simulated depth cameras (three.js, WebGL), captured in headless Chrome
generator.appSourceDigestRule: sha256 over "path\0sha256\n" of src/, index.html, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, package.json, package-lock.json (git ls-files -co --exclude-standard, sorted)
generator.glRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5, Unspecified Version)

mergedClean.note: Processed cloud of the clean variant (input for later candidate generation). Regenerated from the depth files by this script.
